name: @tpmjs/tools-openrouter
description: OpenRouter API tools for AI agents. Chat completions, embeddings, model discovery, API key management, credits, guardrails, and more.

tools.name: chatCompletion
tools.description: Send a chat completion request to any model via OpenRouter.

tools.name: createResponse
tools.description: Create a response using the OpenRouter Responses API (beta).

tools.name: createEmbedding
tools.description: Generate embeddings for text input via OpenRouter.

tools.name: listModels
tools.description: List all available models on OpenRouter with pricing and metadata.

tools.name: countModels
tools.description: Get the total count of available models on OpenRouter.

tools.name: listUserModels
tools.description: List models filtered by user preferences and settings.

tools.name: listEmbeddingModels
tools.description: List all available embedding models on OpenRouter.

tools.name: listProviders
tools.description: List all providers available on OpenRouter.

tools.name: listEndpoints
tools.description: List all available endpoints for a specific model.

tools.name: previewZdr
tools.description: Preview the impact of Zero Data Retention on available endpoints.

tools.name: getCredits
tools.description: Get remaining credits and usage for the current account.

tools.name: createCoinbaseCharge
tools.description: Create a Coinbase Commerce charge for crypto payment.

tools.name: getUserActivity
tools.description: Get user activity grouped by endpoint.

tools.name: getGeneration
tools.description: Get request and usage metadata for a specific generation.

tools.name: listApiKeys
tools.description: List all API keys for the current account.

tools.name: createApiKey
tools.description: Create a new OpenRouter API key.

tools.name: getApiKey
tools.description: Get details of a specific API key by hash.

tools.name: getCurrentApiKey
tools.description: Get details of the currently authenticated API key.

tools.name: updateApiKey
tools.description: Update an existing API key's name, limit, or status.

tools.name: deleteApiKey
tools.description: Delete an API key by hash.

tools.name: listGuardrails
tools.description: List all guardrails in the account.

tools.name: createGuardrail
tools.description: Create a new guardrail policy.

tools.name: getGuardrail
tools.description: Get details of a specific guardrail.

tools.name: updateGuardrail
tools.description: Update an existing guardrail.

tools.name: deleteGuardrail
tools.description: Delete a guardrail by ID.

tools.name: listGuardrailKeyAssignments
tools.description: List all API key assignments across all guardrails.

tools.name: listGuardrailMemberAssignments
tools.description: List all member assignments across all guardrails.

tools.name: getGuardrailKeys
tools.description: List API key assignments for a specific guardrail.

tools.name: assignGuardrailKeys
tools.description: Bulk assign API keys to a guardrail.

tools.name: getGuardrailMembers
tools.description: List member assignments for a specific guardrail.

tools.name: assignGuardrailMembers
tools.description: Bulk assign members to a guardrail.

tools.name: unassignGuardrailKeys
tools.description: Bulk unassign API keys from a guardrail.

tools.name: unassignGuardrailMembers
tools.description: Bulk unassign members from a guardrail.
